name: TDS Sentinel MVP
postCreateCommand: cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt && cp .env.example .env && python3 -c "import secrets; key=secrets.token_hex(32); content=open('.env').read().replace('REEMPLAZA_CON_UN_VALOR_SECRETO_SEGURO', key); open('.env','w').write(content)" && echo '[Sentinel] Entorno listo. Corre: cd backend && python3 app.py'
